## Problem

<!-- What problem is this solving? Knowing this anchors every later decision. -->
<!-- Bad: "Build a tool to manage tasks." -->
<!-- Good: "I lose track of tasks across 4 different note-taking apps. A unified inbox would let me see everything in one place." -->



## Who's affected

<!-- Who feels the pain? "Me" is a valid answer — naming the user keeps the work grounded. -->



## Why the change is needed

<!-- What's the cost of not doing this? What does the workaround look like today? -->



## Success criteria

<!-- Concrete checks that prove this is done. Vague success = endless project. -->
<!-- Bad: "It works." -->
<!-- Good:
- User can upload a CSV and see a parsed table within 2 seconds
- Errors are surfaced inline, not silently swallowed
- Output matches the manual process for the first 5 test files
-->

<!-- Things you're nervous about. Dependencies. Time pressure. Compatibility concerns. -->
